title: The Grand Schedule
description: The Grand Mechanism does not notice intruders. It schedules them. W3's masterite is named as an instrument, not a person, and never says 'I' -- the Schedule has a first rule and no record of who wrote it.

steps.text: The gear-train did not stop when they entered. Nothing in the room acknowledged them at all — and then, seven seconds later, everything did at once, as though the acknowledgement had been scheduled for exactly then.

lines.speaker: The Grand Schedule
lines.text: Not late. Early entries are also variance. The Schedule does not prefer.

lines.speaker: Cleric
lines.text: Who wrote it? The schedule — who made the first rule?

lines.speaker: The Grand Schedule
lines.text: The Schedule has a first rule. The first rule does not record an author.

lines.speaker: The Grand Schedule
lines.text: It is the entire answer. There is no other entry.

lines.speaker: Rogue
lines.text: So nobody's in charge of any of this.

lines.speaker: The Grand Schedule
lines.text: Nothing is in charge. Everything is ON TIME.

lines.speaker: The Grand Schedule
lines.text: A slot has been allocated for this. It was allocated before you arrived. PROCEED.
